answer: Bind each identity to a hardware key that signs every submission inside an enclave. The signature covers the nonce, the epoch and the answer hash. Cut standing one unit for every claim the enclave did not witness. Replay the signed transcript to catch copies, never compare labels. A farm needs one chip per identity, so 1,000 puppets means 1,000 devices and 1,000 chains. That is a spiral of capital, and the violet crystal of an enclave signature cannot be rented.
